definitions.explanation: The quality or degree of being strong, whether in physical power, mental fortitude, or competitive ability.
The degree or intensity of something such as wind, flavor, or a feeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強|つよ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧な{強|つよ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}する→感心する：21451_kanshinsuru⟧。

⟦{逆境|ぎゃっきょう}→逆境：22285_gyakkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧{強|つよ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: He was able to succeed precisely because he had the strength not to give up even in adversity.
The intensity of the wind has been increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強|つよ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}できる→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: You can adjust the strength of the coffee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強|つよ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The intensity of earthquake shaking varies by location.

notes:
The noun form of the i-adjective ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong), formed with the suffix -さ which converts adjectives into nouns expressing degree. This is a highly productive pattern in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧な{強|つよ}さ: mental strength
- ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強|つよ}さ: wind strength
- {強|つよ}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate strength
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強|つよ}さ: true strength

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧: power, force — a broader term for physical or metaphorical power
- ⟦{強度|きょうど}→強度：27803_kyoudo⟧: intensity, strength — technical term used for materials, light, or signals
- ⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧さ: durability, sturdiness — emphasizes resistance to damage or wear
